_doc: Our own town walls' look (KitLook.Wall, kit.gdshader OWN_WALL; E9b1): each house's plaster tint (by its number in props_own.json walls.houses, 0-5) and timber tint (0-2, the tint's number mod 3), sRGB multipliers on the trim sheet's near-white plaster and grey-brown timber; the weathering: grime_h (m above the house's ground) and grime_dark (how much darker at the ground), splash_h and splash_dark (rain off the street), house_rise (the ground storey darker as a whole), stain_dark (streaks under sills), val_noise (broad patches), house_val (each house lighter or darker), occl (the baked occlusion's reach); E9b3: the grime's height is above the terrain itself (OwnWalls' ground map), plaster_mottle (plaster's value at 1-2 m), lost_plaster (patches fallen off to the lath); E9b6: big_lost (the share of 2.5 m cells with a 40-80 cm patch off), plaster_mottle 0.18. Roofs (KitLook.Roof, kit.gdshader OWN_ROOF; E9b2): clay_tints and shingle_tints (by the house's roof tint, props_own.json walls.houses' fourth number, its covering the third), sRGB multipliers on the roof sheet's painted tiles; roof_sag (each roof's own extra sag at most, m, on the generator's), tile_val and tile_warm (each tile's value and warmth again), roof_val_noise, roof_house_val, soot_r (m) and soot_dark (round the chimneys), stack_soot (a stack's top), roof_moss and moss_dir (world x, z: north), roof_occl. E9b6 r4: plaster 4 warmed (it read slate in shade), timber 1 a darker silvered oak (pale, a gable's frame read as hairlines), tile_val 0.14. Env 22 r1f (judge: a salmon clay roof): clay_tints 15-30% less saturated (luminance kept), tile_val 0.2, ridge_soot (the top 0.2-0.8 m of each slope darker, patchy) eave_moss (moss in broken patches on the lowest course or two) and clay_sat (the clay's saturation in the shader, 0.55: the tints alone barely moved it under the warm key).
_w2: L1 W2 town (C4): tints near white (the trim sheet carries each class's hand-set color; houses vary +-4% only), the photo-era weathering off (grime, splash, stains, the ground storey's rise, broad noise, mottle, lost plaster; roof soot, moss, ridge soot, eave moss, the clay's desaturation): rule 9 (one color varied inside its range), MB3 (clean painted surfaces)
